phase_names: Place the strip against the frame lands
Lower the full-length lid
Flex the six clip catches
Slide the six closure clips home
Release the catches into their recesses
Seat the holder in its format collar
Lower the matching mask cap
Turn the four cap locks
Depress the enlarger's spring stage
Align the permanent receiver with the slot
Slide the receiver to the rear stop
Let the stage seat the receiver
Slide the prepared cartridge into the receiver
Lower the two front dock pins
Turn the pins to retain the collar
Collar seated; the strip can now advance
Frame 1 locked at the mask
Retract the index tooth before frame 2
Slide to frame 2
Frame 2: release to register
Retract the index tooth before frame 3
Slide to frame 3
Frame 3: release to register
Retract the index tooth before frame 4
Slide to frame 4
Frame 4: release to register
Release to return to frame 1
Slide back to the original frame
Frame 1 registered again
Unlock the collar from the receiver
Lift the two dock pins
Withdraw the complete cartridge
At the workbench: unlock the mask cap
Lift the mask cap clear
Separate the lower collar from the holder
Release the six clip catches
Withdraw the six closure clips
Lift the lid to release the film
Lift the film clear of all clamping lands
Move the strip one pitch; align the next image group
Lower the film onto the margin supports
Replace the lid
Slide the six closure clips home
Release the catches into their recesses
Reseat the lower collar
Lower the mask cap
Lock the collar; the new group is ready to dock
